name: Verify ambiguous request triggers clarification for ticket type
objective: Validate that when a user describes an ambiguous request, the assistant asks clarifying questions to determine whether it is an Incident or Service Request.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page

steps.testData: "I need something done with my account"

steps.description: Verify the assistant asks clarifying questions
steps.expectedResult: The assistant asks what specifically is needed with the account (access issue, locked out, new access, etc.)

steps.testData: "I am locked out of my account"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant now classifies this as an Incident and proceeds accordingly
